News global nation business lifestyle entertainment technology sports opinion LATEST NEWS STORIES HEADLINES METRO REGIONS NATION WORLD CDN NEWSLETTER Key Moments Related Stories Key moments Related stories Special Coverage LIVE UPDATES: Asean Summit 2026 and related meetings – Nov. 14, 2026 01:56 PM November 14, 2026"> INQUIRER.net / Updated as of: 01:56 PM November 14, 2026 Latest updates Latest Oldest MANILA, Philippines — The red carpet is being rolled out ahead of the anticipated arrival of heads of state, their delegations and other attendees of the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits and other meetings in Manila from Nov. 15 to 18. Meeting and banquet halls have been refurbished, news media briefing rooms have been prepared, and traffic rerouting measures have been put in place as the Philippines hosts the last Asean leaders’ plenary and retreat, along with related meetings among officials and stakeholders of the 11-country bloc, under its chairmanship.
On Saturday, Asean Business Advisory Council Chair Jose Ma. Concepcion III urged big businesses to help uplift smaller businesses across Southeast Asia. Speaking before hundreds of business executives at the Asean Investment Summit, Concepcion said the region’s prosperity must be practical and palpable, particularly for micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs).
LOOK: More photos from the bilateral meeting between President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney at the Philippine International Convention Center in Pasay City. The meeting marked a major milestone in Philippines-Canada trade relations, with both countries concluding negotiations for a Free Trade Agreement aimed at expanding trade and economic opportunities. | 📷: Presidential Communications Office via @luisacabatoINQ Follow our live updates here: https://t.co/FV0VxxJW2J
LOOK: Lexus luxury vehicles to ferry Asean delegates Lexus Philippines is preparing luxury hybrid vehicles to transport delegates during the 49th Asean Summit in Metro Manila from Nov. 15 to 17. The fleet includes Lexus LS 500h sedans and LM 350h luxury vans for official delegates and dialogue partner representatives. All vehicles are on loan and will be returned after the country’s Asean hosting period, the company said. | 📷: Lexus Philippines/Facebook via @gabdumalagINQ Follow our live updates here: https://t.co/FV0VxxJW2J
